763    /**
764     * Return a Malaysian I.C. No.
765     *
766     * @example '890123-45-6789'
767     *
768     * @see https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Malaysian_identity_card#Structure_of_the_National_Registration_Identity_Card_Number_(NRIC)
769     *
770     * @param string|null      $gender 'male', 'female' or null for any
771     * @param bool|string|null $hyphen true, false, or any separator characters
772     *
773     * @return string
774     */
775    public static function myKadNumber($gender = null, $hyphen = false)
776    {
777        // year of birth
778        $yy = self::numberBetween(0, 99);
779
780        // month of birth
781        $mm = DateTime::month();
782
783        // day of birth
784        $dd = DateTime::dayOfMonth();
785
786        // place of birth (1-59 except 17-20)
787        while (in_array($pb = self::numberBetween(1, 59), [17, 18, 19, 20], false)) {
788        }
789
790        // random number
791        $nnn = self::numberBetween(0, 999);
792
793        // gender digit. Odd = MALE, Even = FEMALE
794        $g = self::numberBetween(0, 9);
795
796        //Credit: https://gist.github.com/mauris/3629548
797        if ($gender === static::GENDER_MALE) {
798            $g = $g | 1;
799        } elseif ($gender === static::GENDER_FEMALE) {
800            $g = $g & ~1;
801        }
802
803        // formatting with hyphen
804        if ($hyphen === true) {
805            $hyphen = '-';
806        } elseif ($hyphen === false) {
807            $hyphen = '';
808        }
809
810        return sprintf('%02d%02d%02d%s%02d%s%03d%01d', $yy, $mm, $dd, $hyphen, $pb, $hyphen, $nnn, $g);
811    }
